one_absolute_deadline.defect: startup could consume nearly the whole 600s budget, after which the request joins, TWO independent 60s waits and the 30s drain join each received a FRESH allowance. The declared cap bounded only the first wait, not any path through the script.
one_absolute_deadline.enforcement: arithmetic on one origin, NOT a daemon thread (root said not to call one that)
one_absolute_deadline.repair: a single monotonic origin; every wait passes through Deadline.bounded(); new dispatch stops at the cleanup reserve; elapsed is recorded after cleanup and before finalisation

one_guaranteed_receipt.defect: a missing weight returned 2 with no receipt; a failed Popen and an undecodable log raised before one was written. The runs that failed WORST left the least evidence.
one_guaranteed_receipt.repair: launch intent is persisted before anything is attempted; every exit goes through finalize(), which writes exactly one receipt and returns the status; attempted-versus-started is retained

problems: the manifest declares no usable launcher digest, so there is nothing to verify against
the selected launcher does not match its declared pin

trusted_launch_boundary.defect: the binary was a hardcoded path and the model the first glob hit; neither was hashed before Popen. The supervisor copied m["launcher"]["sha256"] into the `expected` dict, so the reader compared the manifest with ITSELF and the bytes on disk were never read.
trusted_launch_boundary.root_wording: "never treat copying manifest hashes into `expected` as that verification"

what_this_does_not_establish: no smoke was run: mocked clocks, mocked files, no child process, no model, no server
the request-intent/usage retention half of root item 3 is NOT done
nothing here is a trial, episode, roster or scientific datum
